title: Computational Closure of a Finite-Source Cosmological Toy Model: From 1,015,000 Arithmetic Addresses to Spatial Geometry and Effective Quantization
description: An executable finite-source cosmological toy model connects 1,015,000 weighted arithmetic addresses to a 128-cell periodic spatial receiver, a weak spatial metric, relational distance, and an effective quantization readout. It reproduces the calibrated P/D/R fractions (5%, 26.8%, 68.2%) and passes 12 internal and 12 independent audit checks. The independent Fourier residual is approximately 1.3381e-13. This is conditional one-way computational closure, not a first-principles derivation of expansion or quantum mechanics, and not the original MCC 3.0 28-component GR solver.
